about: The "?" window texts (Cody 11/8, items 2 and 10): one per feature guide, then extra ones marked "extra": true for other owner's-portal tabs and windows whose process needs explaining. Cody picks which extras go in from docs/guides/tips-preview.html. Each fits a small window (under 120 words: title, short, steps and if_you_see). on: true puts that tip's "?" in the app (the eight guides; an extra goes live when Cody sets it). tab is the tab's name as the tab bar shows it; anchor is the element the "?" sits beside (place: after it, or inside it at its end); controls are the words the text names, checked on screen by tests/guides_check.mjs from the place open leads to; more points to the guide PDF or the Help window. static/helptips.js draws them; docs/guides/tips-preview.html shows every one.

tips.title: Start: one job, step by step
tips.short: Answer what you know about the building and DAStastic builds the Discovery report: the verdict, who decides, and the radio systems in play. Then it takes the job through Survey, Design and the AHJ package. Every box can stay blank.
steps: Fill in what you have, then press Build the Discovery report.
Press Next to move on. A window lists what the file still needs.
Press Mark as delivered to the AHJ when it's handed over.

if_you_see.see: Add the address for the rest
if_you_see.check: Pick the address from the list, or type lat, lon.
Press Go there for each, or give a reason and Move on.

tips.more: Feature guides PDF, section 1: Discovery, the Start tab

tips.title: Walk me through
tips.short: Reads the job and shows, stage by stage, what's on file and what's missing. Then it asks one question at a time from the first gap and takes you to each place.
steps: Press Walk me through on a job.
Press Walk me through it. Answer each step, or press Take me there.
Auto moves on by itself when the record shows a step done.

if_you_see.see: It picks up at a step you did
if_you_see.check: The record doesn't show it: enter it there, or answer the step.
Note what you measured, then call the person named.

tips.more: Feature guides PDF, section 2: Step by step, Walk me through

tips.title: Prospects
tips.short: Finds buildings that often must carry emergency radio coverage near a place, ranked by an RF need estimate and their newest permit. Each one can get a first email or go on the board as a Lead.
steps: Type a town, address or lat, lon in Where, pick a radius, press Find buildings.
Press a building's RF need verdict for its reasons.
Email writes a first email; + Job makes a Lead.

if_you_see.check: Press Download them now, once.
Enter it in Firm details: the law needs it in every email.

tips.title: The drop spot (Intake)
tips.short: Drop files, folders, zips or old emails anywhere, on any tab. Each file is checked, then filed where it belongs, and nothing already there is written over. Readings and prices wait for your press.
steps: Drag files onto the page, or press Intake, then Choose files or Choose a folder.
Check Going to: the open job, or Work it out from each file.
Apply what's waiting. Undo this drop takes it all back.

if_you_see.check: It could run code or its name lies: ask for a plain PDF.

if_you_see.see: An item under Needs a look
if_you_see.check: Pick what it is and the job, then File it.

tips.more: Feature guides PDF, section 4: The drop spot (Intake)

tips.title: Emails this job needs
tips.short: Every email the job still needs sent sits on one list: the AHJ, the radio shop, the contractor, each licensee and carrier. Ready ones come ticked, and one press sends them from your own mailbox.
steps: Connect your mailbox once: DAS, Mail, Connect and test.
On the job's Overview, read the list. Preview any one.
Press Send once for every ticked row.

if_you_see.see: Connect your mailbox to send these at once
if_you_see.check: No mailbox for your login yet: connect one.

if_you_see.see: A red line about an attached file
if_you_see.check: Put that PDF in the job's Files first.

tips.more: Feature guides PDF, section 5: Email all

tips.title: Cell sites
tips.short: Every cell site around the pin, from OpenCelliD and your own captures, grouped into sites and matched to the nearest FCC tower within 1 km. Click a site for its sectors, bands and tower.
steps: Put the pin down, then open Cell sites.
Narrow it with Operator, Technology or Find.
By tower lists each tower with every carrier on it; By site goes back. CSV, KML and ATAK take the sites with you.

if_you_see.check: Add an OpenCelliD key in Data & updates, or import a country file.
No registered tower near it: normal for rooftops and small cells.

tips.more: Feature guides PDF, section 6: Cell Lab, the Cell sites tab

tips.title: Missions and Find a signal
tips.short: A mission holds one area's field work: targets, captures, the field log and every change. Find a signal, at its top, says where a signal probably is from the levels you read and the directions you take.
steps: Press + New mission, Use current pin, Create mission.
Open Find a signal and type the MHz. At each stop: Use my location, the level, Save this stop.
After 3 stops, press Put the pin there.

if_you_see.check: Press Use my location and allow location.

if_you_see.see: The levels are too even to say yet
if_you_see.check: Spread the stops around it, not in a line.

tips.more: Feature guides PDF, section 7: Mission and Hunt (and Find a signal in DAStastic lite)

tips.title: Push to ATAK and the TAK team
tips.short: Push to ATAK sends what's on the map as live markers to every ATAK, iTAK and WinTAK on this network. Push again to update them. The TAK team layer shows the ATAK users on that network on DAStastic's map.
steps: Search an area, open the filter rail, press Push to ATAK.
Export, ATAK package saves a file for ATAK instead.
Map layers: tick TAK team (this network).

if_you_see.see: No network to send the multicast on
if_you_see.check: Join the team's Wi-Fi, or set a TAK Server in Data & updates.
Same Wi-Fi? Guest Wi-Fi often blocks it: send the package.

tips.more: Feature guides PDF, section 8: ATAK and the TAK team

tips.title: The filter rail
tips.short: The rail filters every tab that lists results: sources, signal type, band, carrier, agency, category and station type. Untick what you don't want; only shows one value alone.
steps: Press › or L to open it. On a phone, the Filters bar.
A pill names each change: press it to undo that one.
Clear goes back to the defaults.

if_you_see.see: Nothing here with the current layers and filters
if_you_see.check: Press Clear, or switch a source back on.

tips.title: Area report
tips.short: Everything licensed around the pin on one page: bands, licensees, technologies and coverage by band. Every survey or crowd signal is checked against the licences, with a claim and a source grade.
steps: Put the pin down and search.
Pick a band under Coverage by band.
Print report prints it as shown.

if_you_see.check: No licence nearby on that frequency: worth a second look, not proof.

tips.title: Analyzer
tips.short: Every result as a record list you filter with an expression, such as type == "DMR" && dbm > -80. Alt + click a cell keeps only that value.
steps: Type an expression and press Apply, or pick a preset. Clear removes it.
The up and down arrows move through records.
Statistics: hierarchy, endpoints, IO graph.

if_you_see.check: The expression doesn't read: check the quotes and the && or ||.

tips.title: Spectrum
tips.short: Every frequency in the results at its exact place under the band plan, drawn at its channel width when zoomed in. Markers say what's on a frequency and can add it to the mission's watch list.
steps: Type From and to, or drag across the plot to zoom.
Click the plot, or type a frequency and press Add, for a marker.
Ctrl + wheel zooms; Shift + drag pans. Band plan and Channel widths switch on and off.

if_you_see.check: No results here: search an area first.

tips.title: Prep sheet
tips.short: A printed checklist for the field: every frequency in the results with a Heard? box to tick on site. It follows the filters, so filter first.
steps: Open the filter rail and set the filters.
Press Export, then Prep sheet.
Print it, or save it as a PDF.

if_you_see.see: Pages of frequencies you don't need
if_you_see.check: Narrow the rail first: by band, agency or signal type.

tips.title: The DAS board
tips.short: Every job is a card in one of eight stages, Lead to Closed, with its next step and dates. Needs you, above the board, lists what's due first.
steps: Press + New job for a Lead.
Drag a card to another stage. A window asks for what's missing, or a reason.
Press a card to open the job.

if_you_see.check: The job's file lacks what that stage needs: Go there, or give a reason.

tips.title: Fault chart
tips.short: 38 charts walked one question at a time: 14 for running a job stage by stage, 24 for faults. Each step says how to check it, what good is and who to call.
steps: Run the job: pick the stage.
Something's wrong: pick the fault.
Answer Yes or No. A stop says who to call.

if_you_see.check: Note what you measured and call who it names.

tips.title: Ready to send
tips.short: Emails DAStastic writes wait here in groups: follow-ups after 5 days, lifecycle reminders, BDA alarms, plans requests and prospect first emails. Nothing goes without your click.
steps: Press Preview to read or edit one.
Tick several and press Send selected. A confirm lists them.
Later puts one off a week; ✕ drops it.

if_you_see.check: An address or a file is missing: Preview says which.

tips.title: Code check
tips.short: The state's rule for this building and how far it was read, with searches for the local amendment and the fire department's guideline. The AHJ confirms it, and their name and the date go in it.
steps: Read What we already hold for this state.
Ask the AHJ: Draft the email, or Copy as a call sheet.
Type what they said, who and when, then Save.

if_you_see.check: Nobody at the AHJ has confirmed it: the stage gate will ask.

tips.title: Pre-survey and consent
tips.short: Which radio systems serve the building and how strong they are inside, from FCC licences. The systems you tick are the channel plan, and each licensee gets a consent letter.
steps: Tick the systems; Tick fire, police, EMS, 911 picks the usual set.
Consent letters prints one per licensee; Email them sends them.
Donor aiming sheet says where to point the roof antenna.

if_you_see.check: Its licence has no FCC contact: nothing is guessed. Call the radio shop.

tips.title: Grid test
tips.short: Each floor split into squares, a reading per square, pass or fail by the AHJ's numbers. Only an instrument calibrated within 12 months counts toward pass or fail.
steps: Pick what's taking the readings in Taken with.
Click a square to enter its readings, or press Import results.
Walk logs readings as you move.

if_you_see.check: No calibrated instrument on the job: add it on the Overview with its date.

tips.more: Help window: DAS (Grid test) and Android app

tips.title: Design: link budget and walls
tips.short: Each band's link budget from the donor to the far edge and back, with every default's source shown. Antennas and coverage draws walls on each floor plan and predicts coverage through them.
steps: Link budget: fill what you know. A cleared box takes its default.
Antennas and coverage: draw walls (W), place antennas (A).
Fit to the walk tunes the model to your readings.

if_you_see.check: Load it on Plans, or drop the PDF on Intake.

tips.more: Help window: Walls on floor plans

tips.title: Report and seal
tips.short: The acceptance test report and the design submittal, built from the job. Print as final (sealed) prints a verify code on it, and the saved PDF dropped anywhere files itself on the job.
steps: Read it through; fix gaps on their tabs.
Press Print as final (sealed), save as PDF, drop it on Intake.
Email the AHJ attaches it. Packet files (zip) downloads the whole AHJ packet.

if_you_see.see: A filed report left the package
if_you_see.check: The job changed after sealing: seal it again.

tips.title: BDA alarms (Monitoring)
tips.short: Takes SNMP alarm traps from any maker's BDA, files each on its job, and names the NFPA 1225 signal. A BDA silent 24 hours reads not heard from.
steps: Press Switch on (UDP 1162 unless you change it).
Add BDA with its name, SNMP version and community.
An open alarm lines up an email to the owner in Ready to send.

if_you_see.see: No traps arrive on the server
if_you_see.check: The firewall has to let that UDP port in from the buildings.

tips.title: Pitch deck
tips.short: A deck a DAS firm shows a building owner: why coverage, how a job runs, what you get and who else does the work, from cited sources. Pick a job for a slide on that building.
steps: Pick a building in For a building, or none for a general deck.
Fill Your firm's details once: they go on every slide.
Print / save as PDF prints one slide per page.

if_you_see.see: Your firm's name missing on the slides
if_you_see.check: Fill Your firm's details and save.

tips.title: Equipment & people
tips.short: Your firm's instruments with serial and calibration dates, and your people with FCC GROL and NICET. Jobs pick from this list, and reminders come before each runs out.
steps: Add an instrument: model, serial, calibrated, runs out, then Add to the list.
Add a person with their certificates.
Drop a calibration certificate on Intake to update a date.

if_you_see.see: Grid test readings that don't count
if_you_see.check: That instrument's calibration is out of date: update it here.

tips.title: Stop all downloads
tips.short: Stop all downloads stops every download at its next megabyte and starts nothing, automatic updates included, until Resume downloads. The data you had is kept.
steps: Press Stop all downloads on a slow or paid connection.
Press Resume downloads when you're back on Wi-Fi.
Updates use Wi-Fi and Ethernet unless you tick Cellular / phone tether.

if_you_see.see: A source that says why it isn't downloading
if_you_see.check: Read its line: off, no key, failed, or stopped.

tips.title: Field packs
tips.short: A field pack carries licences, towers, broadcast, NOAA, FAA, 911 centres, microwave links and prospect buildings for the web version and DAStastic lite. It never carries your work, keys or crowd layers.
steps: Type the states, or put the pin down.
Press Make a pack for these states, or Make a pack around the pin.
On the phone, load it in lite's Packs tab.

if_you_see.check: No pack is loaded on that phone: load one from Packs.

controls: Make a pack for these states
Make a pack around the pin
tips.more: Help window: Where your files are

tips.title: People and logins
tips.short: The admin adds each person with a role: View, Full or Admin, or AHJ reviewer for shared jobs only. Their password shows once, and a last day ends a temporary login.
steps: Type the name, pick what they can do, set a Last day if it's temporary.
Press Add and make a password, and hand it over.
Reset or remove from the person's row.

if_you_see.check: Eight wrong passwords in 15 minutes locks a name for 15 minutes.

tips.title: Your API keys
tips.short: Keys for WiGLE, OpenCelliD, aisstream, Mouser, Digi-Key, Shippo and the FCC Broadband Map are sealed outside every database file. No copy, kit or backup carries them, and they never show again.
steps: Paste each key in its box.
Press Save keys.
A source that needs one says needs key until it's in.

if_you_see.check: Paste that source's key here and save.

tips.title: Notes
tips.short: On every screen: a voice note, the screen recorded while you talk, a photo, or just words. Each keeps the time, the screen, the pin and the mission.
steps: Press Note, or the N key.
Pick voice, screen, photo or words, and save.
Share with Cody, then Send email now, sends it as a numbered report.

if_you_see.see: It asks for your send code
if_you_see.check: It's in the link Cody sent you, asked the first time only.
